title: Bottom navigation bar: remove redundant duplicate of sidebar navigation, or justify with mobile-first purpose
goal: Every screen shows a sticky bottom navigation bar: 'Intake | Mission Control | Agents | Findings | Reports | Settings'. This exactly duplicates a subset of the sidebar navigation. Two navigation systems doing the same thing creates confusion and wastes 44px of screen space on every page. Evaluate and take one of these actions: (1) PREFERRED: Remove the bottom nav bar entirely. Desktop operators use the sidebar. If mobile is not a supported use case, the bar has no purpose. (2) ALTERNATIVE: If mobile is a target use case, repurpose the bottom bar as a mobile-ONLY nav (display:none above 640px) and make the sidebar mobile-hidden. Choose option 1 unless there is an active mobile story. The bottom nav is rendered from BOTTOM_NAV_ITEMS in app.js — remove or gate the render. Remove associated CSS from styles.css. Run E2E tests to ensure no test relies on the bottom nav.
scope: Visual audit 2026-05-03: all screen screenshots show the bottom nav bar 'Intake | Mission Control | Agents | Findings | Reports | Settings' which duplicates the sidebar. There is no documented mobile requirement for AegisPT.
generation_reason: Visual audit 2026-05-03: bottom nav bar is a redundant duplicate of the sidebar — wastes 44px and creates two navigation systems.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Only remove or gate the bottom nav bar. Do not change sidebar navigation, topbar, or any other navigation system.
